title: bug: What's Up Docker (WUD) Integration Won't Connect with Username and Password
body:
### Describe the bug

First, I love your app, thank you so much!

I'm trying to use the WUD integration with Homarr, but it will not connect if using a username and password with WUD. The WUD integration works fine if you do not use a username and password with WUD. I am using Homarr version 1.76.0, via Unraid Apps.

### Steps to reproduce

If I disable WUD username and password in my docker compose, and select "No Secrets" in the Homarr WUD integration, it works just fine.

However if I enable username and password in WUD and select "Usernamd & Password" in the Homarr WUD integration it does not work.

I have tried entering my password normally in the password field of the integration setup, I have tried entering the hash of my password with double "$$" (as is required for setting up WUD in docker compose) and I have tried entering the hash of my password with single "$" as is displayed when you first hash your password.

### Impact

I am unable to use the WUD integration with Homarr and keep my WUD behind username and password authentication.

### Additional information

I can't think of anything else to try.

I'm not a programmer, but I'm happy to work with you and test!

Thank you for your help!

### Version

1.76.0

### Installation method

Unraid Apps

### Browser

Firefox
